name: Bictorys

sources.quote: Veuillez noter que la validation de votre compte dépend de la vérification des documents obligatoires requis.

open_questions: Bictorys says account validation depends on mandatory documents, but neither docs.bictorys.com, bictorys.com, its terms (https://infos.bictorys.com/termes-conditions/) nor the sign-up form (https://register.bictorys.com) lists them or says whether an individual without a registered business can open an account.

description: Bictorys is a payment infrastructure provider serving West and Central Africa, supporting mobile money and card payments across multiple countries through a unified API.
example_prompt: Accept mobile money and card payments across West and Central Africa using a single unified API — covering checkout flows, disbursements, invoicing, and recurring billing.
